H1.usage: STRICTLY ONE per page. Used for the Hero title.
H1.classes: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-serif text-white tracking-tight leading-none

H2.usage: Used for major section titles (About Me, Services, Market Pulse).

H3.usage: Used for card titles, deal tickers, blog post titles, and service items.
H3.classes: text-xl md:text-2xl font-sans font-medium text-white/90 tracking-normal

body.classes: text-base md:text-lg font-sans font-light text-white/60 leading-relaxed

overline.classes: text-xs font-sans font-semibold text-lime-400 uppercase tracking-[0.2em]

typography.rationale: Cormorant Garamond provides the 'Uber-rich', editorial, and advisory feel aligning with the Playfair logo, while Outfit brings a highly modern, data-rich tech edge to the body copy.

layouts.hero: Full viewport height. Split or asymmetric layout with animated portrait/film on one side, and high-impact H1 with lime-green accent CTA on the other. Include a subtle floating Stats Band overlapping the bottom edge.
layouts.services_grid: Bento-style grid (cols-1 md:cols-12). Wide gaps (gap-8). Cards span varying columns to avoid rigid symmetry.
layouts.market_pulse: High-density data row/ticker layout. Dense, crisp typography using Outfit tabular-nums.
layouts.spacing: Generous. Use py-24 or py-32 for section padding. Container padding px-6 md:px-12.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/10 for the floating navigation and sticky elements.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp inner borders (border-white/10) to define structure instead of heavy shadows. Gives the 'Uber' structural tech feel.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Cards should slightly lift (-translate-y-1) and reveal a subtle lime-green ambient shadow (shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(198,241,53,0.1)]).
visual_enhancers.favicon: Use 'SK' initials in Playfair Display, Lime Green on Black background.

motion.page_load: Fade and slight upward drift (framer-motion initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}).
motion.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. Stagger grid item entrances.
motion.ticker: Continuous marquee for Market Pulse / Deals Ticker using react-fast-marquee. Seamless, slow, horizontal drift.

business_consulting.description: Professional business meeting context, hands gesturing.

energy_transition.description: Modern white wind turbines against a clear sky.

sudarshan_portrait.description: Premium male portrait in dark suit against dark background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure global CSS imports Cormorant Garamond and Outfit from Google Fonts.
Implement a strictly dark theme. DO NOT use generic Vercel/Stripe templates.
Header MUST NOT be fully transparent. Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with a bottom border.
Enforce SEO H-tag rules: Wrap the main hero text in <h1>. Section titles like 'About Me' in <h2>. Card titles in <h3>.
All service pages (except 1:1 consultation) must use the specific industry images (business_consulting, energy_transition) instead of Sudarshan's photo.
The 1:1 Consultation page and About page should feature the 'sudarshan_portrait'.
Integrate Shadcn components (buttons, inputs) but style them with the dark/lime-green palette.
Buttons should be modern pill-shaped or slightly rounded (rounded-md) with Lime Green background and dark text.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements, links, and forms.

accessibility.contrast: Lime Green (#C6F135) on Dark Grey (#050505 / #111111) provides excellent contrast. Ensure disabled text remains legible (at least 4.5:1).
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C6F135] focus:outline-none).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not apply 'transition: all'. Target specific properties (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform).
Avoid generic centered layouts. Use left alignment for readability unless in specific hero/banner contexts.
Create depth with layered z-indexes and 1px borders, rather than muddy shadows.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖, 💡, 🚀) as icons. Use Lucide icons.
